title: Finite local zero cover for an etale sheaf colimit section
statement: From a section whose image is zero in a filtered colimit sheaf on a quasi-compact etale object, extract a finite family of etale arrows with local eventual vanishing and the separatedness implication.

proof.text: Apply AlgebraicGeometry.etale_section_colimit_local_zero_sieve to the zero colimit image. It supplies a covering sieve S such that the restriction along every arrow of S is killed by a transition out of i.

Apply the already proved source-library AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.exists_finite_affine_of_mem_smallEtaleTopology (WeilConjectures/AlgebraicGeometry/Sites/CohomologyColimit.lean:71) to S. It gives a family indexed by Fin n, with every arrow in S and with jointly surjective underlying maps. Lift this index to ULift (Fin n) in the diagram universe. Scheme.ofArrows_mem_smallEtaleTopology_iff shows that the lifted family is covering. Its local vanishing data is the preceding conclusion applied to each selected arrow.

For any diagram stage j and section t whose restrictions along the selected family are zero, form the linear map from the lifted rank-one module ULift Lambda sending a to a.down times t. Its compositions with all covering restrictions are zero by linearity. Presheaf.IsSheaf.hom_ext_ofArrows applied to the stage sheaf makes this map zero; evaluating at the lifted unit gives t = 0. Combine the finite family, its local killing data, and this separatedness implication.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0738(2), local equality and finite-cover selection; existing proved finite affine refinement and rank-one sheaf separatedness.

theorem etale_section_colimit_finite_zero_cover
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (Λ : Type v) [CommRing Λ]
    (U : X.Etale) [CompactSpace U.left]
    (I : Type w) [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I]
    (G : I ⥤ Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{max v w} Λ))
    (c : Cocone G) (hc : IsColimit c) (i : I)
    (s : (G.obj i).obj.obj (Opposite.op U))
    (hs : ((c.ι.app i).hom.app (Opposite.op U)).hom s = 0) :
    ∃ (K : Type w) (_ : Finite K) (V : K → X.Etale) (q : ∀ k, V k ⟶ U),
      (∀ k, ∃ (j : I) (f : i ⟶ j),
        ((G.map f).hom.app (Opposite.op (V k))).hom
          (((G.obj i).obj.map (q k).op).hom s) = 0) ∧
      (∀ (j : I) (t : (G.obj j).obj.obj (Opposite.op U)),
        (∀ k, ((G.obj j).obj.map (q k).op).hom t = 0) → t = 0)
